text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing the terrifying strength of 
Oguri Cap and the others firsthand,
Mejiro 
Ardan declares that she will be the one
to win at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Inari One reveals that the 
entire "Eternal Big Three" will gather at 
the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's heart races at the thought 
of the "Eternal Big Three" gathering in 
one place. The focal point of history,
the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), was just around the 
corner—
